summary: Fixed finite ProductSet subset checks using lazy membership iteration, added capability-based FiniteSet rewrite (including Range factors), symmetric ProductSet/FiniteSet equality, extensional proper subset/superset semantics, and safe simplification of symbolic set equality. Regression coverage includes original example, Range, both operand orders, equal/unequal/proper relations, unknown membership, nested products, non-enumerable sets, and large finite products. Public tests: sympy/sets/tests plus sympy/core/tests/test_relational.py: 253 passed, 8 expected failures, no failures. git diff --check passed. No hidden tests run.
